immigration.text: He said hardworking immigrants should have a straightforward path to U.S. citizenship while recognizing border security.
immigration.quote: While recognizing that a county has the right to secure its borders, the Democrat argued that hardworking immigrants nevertheless deserve a simple, straight-forward path to U.S. citizenship.

health.text: Crosby supports a single-payer system and expanding Medicare to cover more Americans.
health.quote: Medicare, when well-funded and supported, works great for seniors. Why not expand this great program to include more Americans?

immigration.text: He called for more work visas while also supporting a large border wall.
immigration.quote: We should have a big wall and a big door that swings both ways.

cannabis.text: He supported legal access to medical cannabis for patients and cited scientific literature supporting its use.
cannabis.quote: Like many of my physician colleagues, I look forward to having the option of getting my suffering patients legal access to this remedy.

tax.text: He supports asking people who can afford it to pay more taxes to provide relief for working families and public goods.
tax.quote: People who can afford to pay more taxes should do so in order to provide relief for working families.

debt.text: He supports reducing the national debt through spending cuts and says raising the retirement age and reforming health care spending may be needed.
debt.quote: Raising the retirement age, increasing the social security tax ceiling, reforming healthcare spending, and reducing military costs are all likely important parts of a real solution.

immigration.text: He supports expanding legal immigration pathways and a pathway to citizenship, while also saying immigration should be regulated to prevent fraud or exploitation.
immigration.quote: we must improve our immigration system to create a robust pathway to citizenship. This includes encouraging international students to stay here for their careers and expanding legal pathways to create opportunity for all.

guns.text: He says thorough background checks and safe storage education can help protect public safety while respecting gun rights.
guns.quote: We should not be afraid to borrow some successful policies from other countries with strong firearm traditions, such as thorough background checks, safe storage education campaigns, and serious consequences for criminal misuse.

abortion.text: He describes abortion as a moral ill but supports legal exceptions for medically indicated cases and pregnancies resulting from rape or incest.
abortion.quote: I believe that the fetus possesses dignity and aborting it is a moral ill.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He says biological sex can make competition in women's sports unfair, while arguing that related policy decisions should be considered individually.
gender.quote: In women's sports, it can be unfair for biological females to compete against biological males.

health.text: He says he would prefer either a fully public universal system or abolishing taxpayer-funded health care, rather than the current mixed system.
health.quote: Although a case for effective reform could be made with any of these options, I would prefer either (A) or (D).

energy.text: He supports an energy portfolio that includes nuclear power, fossil fuels, renewables, and grid innovation.
energy.quote: To meet our ever-growing demand for energy, a portfolio of nuclear power, fossil fuels, renewables, and innovation in storage and transmission is necessary.

voting.text: He opposes voting without photo identification and supports an ID requirement if eligible voters can obtain valid identification.
voting.quote: If this policy promotes confidence and all eligible voters are able to obtain valid identification, it can be a worthwhile requirement.

tax.text: He praised the 2017 tax cuts and argued that families should keep more of their money rather than pay higher taxes for government spending.
tax.quote: Americans deserve a tax code that values their hard work and keeps hard-earned dollars in their pockets.

wages.text: He said he opposes a higher mandatory federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: I'm against unnecessary regulations, wasteful federal spending, and policies like a higher mandatory federal minimum wage that unintentionally but directly lead to higher childcare costs.

trade.text: He supports tariffs in some sectors while also backing trade agreements and lower trade barriers with allies.
trade.quote: On one hand, this means leveraging tariffs in certain sectors like steel and aluminum and anti-dumping measures to respond to IP theft and illegal subsidies. On the other hand, this means negotiating new and enforceable trade agreements

debt.text: Moore’s debt and deficit task force report proposes Social Security and Medicare changes, including means testing, raising the eligibility age, and changing cost-of-living adjustments.
debt.quote: Instead, we could strengthen the program by envisioning it as an anti-poverty benefit, adjusting the eligibility age, and tying cost of living adjustments to chained CPI or other indexes of inflation.

housing.text: He reintroduced a bill that encourages more housing near transit and rewards local policies that reduce barriers to construction.
housing.quote: reintroduced the bipartisan, bicameral Build More Housing Near Transit Act to encourage the construction of low- and middle-income housing in transit-served, walkable locations.

schools.text: He said he strongly supports parent choice, including charter-school and homeschool options.
schools.quote: I strongly believe in parent choice and input when it comes to classroom and curriculum transparency and charter school and homeschool options.

safety.text: He supports empowering law enforcement and backed legislation targeting international fentanyl trafficking and drug cartels.
safety.quote: I will support policies that protect law enforcement’s ability to protect and serve while also demanding accountability when breaches of trust occur.

immigration.text: He supports border walls, E-Verify, more border agents, and requiring asylum seekers to wait in Mexico.
immigration.quote: I also want to be clear that I believe that means a wall where it makes sense and the implementation of high-tech virtual walls where physical construction isn't possible or plausible.

guns.text: He calls himself a strong Second Amendment supporter, cosponsored concealed-carry reciprocity legislation, and opposes efforts to weaken gun rights.
guns.quote: I will oppose any efforts aimed at weakening the Second Amendment.

abortion.text: He supported overturning Roe v. Wade and said Republicans should continue protecting unborn children.
abortion.quote: As one of the over 200 Republicans in Congress who urged this reversal, I am pleased that states will now have the chance to enact protections for babies and mothers.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which restricts participation in girls’ and women’s sports based on sex.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

cannabis.text: He voted against the MORE Act, federal legislation to remove cannabis from the federal controlled-substances list.
cannabis.quote: HR 3617: Marijuana Opportunity Reinvestment and Expungement (MORE) Act

health.text: He favors competitive-market approaches to prescription drug costs and supports expanding options such as health savings accounts for people with insurance.
health.quote: Instead of promoting egregious government control of prescription drug pricing, like what is included in the Democrats’ partisan Inflation Reduction Act, the Lower Costs, More Cures Act seeks to address pricing issues while ensuring a healthy competitive marketplace for life-saving cures.

energy.text: He supports expanding domestic energy production and promoting energy independence.
energy.quote: We must also support our domestic energy industry and promote energy independence.

voting.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he strongly disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification. Strongly Disagree

debt.text: He advocates balanced budgets and reducing the national debt.
debt.quote: Carlton Bowen will fight for fiscal responsibility, honest budgeting, and a Congress that remembers it is not authorized to spend without limit

immigration.text: He called for enforcing existing immigration laws and prosecuting organizations and officials who conspire to bypass them.
immigration.quote: We need to enforce existing U.S. Laws regarding immigration. The surge in illegal immigration isn't because our laws are defective

energy.text: He supports drilling and fracking, reliable coal and natural gas power, and plentiful, cheap electricity.
energy.quote: There needs to be enough baseload power though from reliable electric sources such as coal and natural gas fired power plants to ensure a cheap and reliable electric grid.
